semantic_reason: The issue reports a memory leak/exponential duplication bug in the NegatedIsNil check where the issues list is concatenated with itself for each subsequent guarded function, producing 3^n entries and consuming all memory. The patch fixes the traversal by passing an empty list `[]` instead of `issues` when recursing into when-clause subexpressions, preventing duplicate issue accumulation. This corrects existing erroneous behavior rather than adding new functionality.
